item.text: {"summary":"The forecast is internally coherent and evidence-based, but it needs source-contract and ordering corrections before publication.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"resolver","severity":"blocking","summary":"The draft's `resolutionSource` names “BEA Personal Income and Outlays, Table 2.6,” which does not match the canonical ledger resolver text/source binding (ALFRED DSPI CSV, Table 1); the target description also calls the measure Table 2.6 line 27 without reconciling that discrepancy.","actionRequested":"Set `resolutionSource` exactly to the canonical ledger source description, retain the supplied ALFRED URL/rule unchanged, and remove or explicitly qualify unsupported Table 2.6 references."},{"rubricItem":"base_rate","severity":"warning","summary":"The base-rate/persistence prior is stated only after the BEA and BLS inside-view evidence.","actionRequested":"Reorder the reasoning so the historical reference class, mean-change prior, and model/dispersion assumptions appear before contemporary evidence and its adjustment."},{"rubricItem":"interval","severity":"warning","summary":"The interval is mechanically calculated from realized monthly-change dispersion, but it relies on only four changes and does not acknowledge the resulting estimation uncertainty.","actionRequested":"State that the four-change sample is sparse and explain why the chosen 80% normal-width interval remains appropriate, or use a broader explicitly justified uncertainty method."}],"optionalSuggestions":["Explain how the June payroll signal maps quantitatively to the +$14.3 billion adjustment.","Use the canonical resolver terminology consistently in the title/question context as well as the JSON resolver fields."]}
